name: Picrotoxin
summary: Picrotoxin, also known as cocculin, is a poisonous crystalline plant compound. It was first isolated by the French pharmacist and chemist Pierre François Guillaume Boullay (1777–1869) in 1812. The name "picrotoxin" is a combination of the Greek words "picros" (bitter) and "toxicon" (poison).

pharmacology.text: Some crustacean muscle fibers have excitatory and inhibitory innervation. Picrotoxin blocks inhibition. Two different but related theories have been proposed for the mechanism by which picrotoxin acts on synapses. One theory is that it acts as a non-competitive channel blocker for GABAA receptor chloride channels, specifically the gamma-aminobutyric acid-activated chloride ionophore.

uses.en: It is used in the laboratory to block GABA-A receptor channels and study inhibition in the nervous system. It was once used as a stimulant in poisoning cases.
uses.zh: 它在實驗室中用來阻斷 GABA-A 受體通道，研究神經系統的抑制作用。過去也曾在中毒案例中用作興奮劑。
uses.zhHans: 它在实验室中用来阻断 GABA-A 受体信道，研究神经系统的抑制作用。过去也曾在中毒案例中用作兴奋剂。

sideEffects.en: It is a poison. By removing the brain's main inhibition it causes vomiting, muscle twitching and violent convulsions, which can be fatal.
sideEffects.zh: 它是一種毒物。由於去除了大腦的主要抑制作用，它會造成嘔吐、肌肉抽動與劇烈抽搐，可能致死。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它是一种毒物。由于去除了大脑的主要抑制作用，它会造成呕吐、肌肉抽动与剧烈抽搐，可能致死。

fact.en: It comes from the seeds of the climbing plant Anamirta cocculus, which were once thrown into water to stun fish. The French chemist Pierre Boullay first isolated it in 1812.
fact.zh: 它來自攀緣植物防己科 Anamirta cocculus 的種子，這些種子過去曾被丟入水中使魚昏迷。法國化學家皮耶．布萊在 1812 年首次分離出它。
fact.zhHans: 它来自攀缘植物防己科 Anamirta cocculus 的种子，这些种子过去曾被丢入水中使鱼昏迷。法国化学家皮耶．布莱在 1812 年首次分离出它。
